instructionId.description: Equal to the Idempotency-Key the initiating caller sent — no separate ID space.

direction.description: OUTBOUND = money PaymentAPI sends out (disbursement). INBOUND = money PaymentAPI received and is notifying AccountAPI about (repayment/payoff receipt) via receiveRepaymentNotification.

partyId.description: Destination party for OUTBOUND; null for INBOUND (payer identity stays inside PaymentAPI's own store, never surfaced here).

journalEntryId.description: The GLPostingAPI entry that authorizes (OUTBOUND) or resulted from (INBOUND) this instruction. Reference only — GLPostingAPI remains the sole source of truth for the entry itself.
